title: Location-indicator shader reads its drawable UBO from the global paint params binding
expect_note: the binding exists and has the right descriptor type; what disagrees is the block behind it (80-byte LocationIndicatorUBO declared over the 48-byte GlobalPaintParamsUBO), so host-layout is the closest code
expected_finding: the shader declares LocationIndicatorUBO (float4x4 matrix + float4 color, 80 bytes) at set 0 binding 0, where the host binds the 48-byte GlobalPaintParamsUBO; the drawable UBO the host writes is at binding 4
